candidate.definition_en: A person whom one does not know.
candidate.explanation_ar: شخص غريب متعرفوش وأول مرة تشوفه.

senses.definition_en: A person whom one does not know.
senses.explanation_ar: شخص غريب لا تعرفه ولم يسبق لك مقابلته.
examples: She felt uneasy talking to a stranger on the train.
I felt like a stranger in my own town.
A complete stranger offered to help her with the heavy luggage.
